request.questionText: There is a key distinction between statistical significance and practical significance. Which of the following statements is accurate with respect to these concepts? Select TRUE or FALSE for each statement below:

blanks.label: Evaluating practical significance necessarily involves subjective judgment on what effect sizes are large enough to matter in context.
We are assessing statistical significance when we interpret confidence intervals solely in terms of whether zero appears in the interval.
We consider practical significance when interpreting confidence intervals in terms of a range of values in the same measurement units as the focal variable.
Effects of a research study labeled as "statistically significant" are certain to be meaningful for stakeholders in the relevant industry.
